A DIFC entity, Sarwa Digital Wealth Limited (DFSA ref F004501), is shown on the DFSA register as a withdrawn authorised firm from 14 Jun 2024, per a DFSA register search snippet (page not opened, 403). The ultimate holding company is not named in any source opened. Saudi CMA granted 'Sarwa' a FinTech Experimental Permit for robo-advisory on 5 Jan 2021; current status unknown.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Sarwa is an ADGM-regulated (FSRA Category 3C) direct-to-consumer investing app. It says it passed USD 1bn of client assets in May 2026 and 300,000 registered users by Dec 2025 (unaudited company claims). Sarwa Invest offers automated ETF portfolios (Conventional, SRI, Crypto with 5% Bitcoin, Halal) built from Vanguard/BlackRock ETFs, with fees falling from 0.85% to 0.4% by balance tier. Sarwa Trade gives US stocks/ETFs, fractional shares and US options (Level 2, since Oct 2024) through Alpaca's Broker API. Sarwa Save invests cash in money market funds, including a Halal option in the Emirates Islamic Money Market Fund. Sarwa Private Wealth (early 2025, >USD 500k) adds dedicated advisors, financial planning and 'public & private asset classes'. A Black Swan Protection Program with Universa Investments (2025) is available from the Platinum tier. All products are US-market or global ETF based: no UAE/GCC equities, bonds or structured products were found.

private_banking.detail: Not a bank ('Sarwa is not a bank'). Sarwa Private Wealth, launched early 2025 for clients with >USD 500k, gives a dedicated wealth advisor (one advisor named on the product page), financial planning, tax optimisation, a professional network (wills, real estate, home financing, legal, tax) and portfolios built by the in-house investment team.

asset_management.detail: FSRA permission 'Managing Assets' (effective 20 Feb 2020). In-house investment team runs automated model portfolios (Sarwa Invest) and Private Wealth mandates. No own-branded funds found. The company labels end-2025 assets as USD 880m 'AUM' and May 2026 client assets as USD 1bn (broad measures, see metrics).

brokerage.detail: Sarwa Trade (launched 2022): 10,000+ US stocks and ETFs on the product page (llms.txt says 5,000+), fractional shares, market/limit orders, USD 1 or 0.25% commission, USD 500 minimum, free AED local transfers. US options (Level 1–2, USD 4 per contract) since Oct 2024. Execution and clearing by Alpaca Securities through the Broker API (fully disclosed); safety page says Trade assets are held with BMO Harris. FSRA permission 'Arranging Deals in Investments'. US markets only.

digital_investing.detail: Sarwa mobile app and web app (English/Arabic): Invest, Trade, Crypto, Save and Private Wealth in one account, funded from UAE AED accounts at zero cost. Onboarding is fully digital.

advisory.detail: FSRA permission 'Advising on Investments or Credit' (effective 16 Aug 2020). Human advice through dedicated Private Wealth/Legacy advisors; automated advice through Sarwa Invest.

discretionary.detail: Sarwa Invest is automated discretionary portfolio management (risk-based ETF portfolios, smart rebalancing, dividend reinvestment). Private Wealth portfolios are managed by the in-house team. Saudi CMA ExPermit (Jan 2021) covered automated discretionary management.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Robo-advisor since 2018. Four portfolio families: Conventional (Vanguard and BlackRock ETFs), Socially Responsible (screened ETFs), Crypto (conventional or SRI plus 5% Bitcoin) and Halal (sukuk, gold ETCs, Shariah-compliant ETFs). Risk slider runs 0–7.

funds_platform.detail: No third-party mutual fund shelf. Sarwa Save puts cash into money market funds (Save+: unnamed MMF, est. 3.8%; Halal: Emirates Islamic Money Market Fund, est. 4.2%, before a 0.5% fee).

structured_products.detail: None found on product, pricing or Private Wealth pages. The Black Swan Protection Program is an options-based tail hedge run with Universa (2% of protected amount for about 12 months; USD 50k minimum, per help-centre search snippet), not a structured note.

private_markets.detail: The Private Wealth page and llms.txt say clients can invest across 'public & private asset classes' / 'public and private market access', but no private-markets product, manager or vehicle is named.

islamic_wealth.detail: Halal robo portfolios (sukuk, gold ETCs, Shariah-compliant ETFs) and a Halal Save option (Emirates Islamic Money Market Fund). Sarwa states it does NOT hold an FSRA Islamic Window endorsement.

Moving upmarket: Private Wealth (>USD 500k) and Legacy (>USD 5m) tiers with dedicated advisors launched early 2025, claiming 'public & private asset classes' with no named private-markets vehicle (S6, S7, S17).
